description: Defines a finite state machine class for managing UHD radio transmit stream states, including handling events like start, end, and underflow during transmission.

classes.name: radio_uhd_tx_stream_fsm
classes.description: Manages the states and events of a UHD radio transmit stream, including handling transmission start, end, underflow, and stop events.

methods.name: init_successful
methods.description: Sets the state to START_BURST indicating successful initialization.

methods.name: async_event_late_underflow
methods.description: Handles late or underflow events, transitioning to END_OF_BURST if currently transmitting.

methods.name: async_event_end_of_burst_ack
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of end-of-burst, transitioning back to START_BURST.

methods.name: on_transmit
methods.description: Determines whether to transmit a block based on current state and event parameters, managing burst states accordingly.

methods.name: on_stop
methods.description: Indicates if an end-of-burst is required when stopping the UHD radio.
